ruleDefinitions.name: PUA - CleanWipe Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the use of CleanWipe a tool usually used to delete Symantec antivirus.

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\SepRemovalToolNative\\_x64\\\.exe$") OR (process_path = RGX("\\\\CATClean\\\.exe$") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-uninstall.*")) OR (process_path = RGX("\\\\NetInstaller\\\.exe$") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-r.*")) OR (process_path = RGX("\\\\WFPUnins\\\.exe$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/uninstall.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/enterprise.*"))))
